pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp, angular edge gradients. Patches on the flank exhibit larger spatial area compared to the smaller, more densely packed patches on the neck. Internal patch texture shows darker brown central pixels with a subtle shift to lighter brown at the perimeter.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological web of cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with noticeable narrowing as the network extends toward the ventral and cervical regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a consistent, low-amplitude serrated silhouette. The frequency of the jagged peaks is high and regular against the background sky and foliage.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A cluster of raised, nodular protrusions is visible on the lower posterior flank and upper hind limb region. A faint, vertical linear mark is present on the mid-flank, potentially indicative of a healed scar or skin fold.
